overview: This single-page Department of State list of papers, dated October 12, 1945, inventories two earlier records concerning military affairs in Taiwan: a December 1941 Justice Department memorandum about the Kaohsiung area of southern Taiwan and a July 1943 communication from Chongqing transmitting two documents containing principally military information about Taiwan. It also records a cross-reference to file 894A.7942.

people.name: George Atcheson Jr.
people.role: U.S. diplomat associated with the Chongqing communication numbered 1374

subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers on military affairs in Taiwan
subfiles.about: An index sheet identifies two earlier documents containing information about military affairs in Taiwan.
subfiles.summary: The sheet lists a Justice Department memorandum dated December 1, 1941, concerning the Province of Takao in southern Taiwan. It also lists communication no. 1374 from China (Chongqing), associated with Atcheson and dated July 21, 1943, which transmitted two documents containing information principally of a military character about Taiwan. A note directs the reader to file 894A.7942; the OCR also preserves an unclear December 1, 1943 date in the second entry.

interest: The page is useful as a provenance and file-control record rather than as substantive intelligence itself. It shows that information about Taiwan’s defenses was being collected through both Justice Department channels in 1941 and diplomatic reporting from wartime Chongqing in 1943. Its reference to two transmitted documents and to file 894A.7942 may help historians locate related military-intelligence material that is absent from this surviving bundle.
